phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.84: Navigation rebuilt around the bottom dock — the content pane no longer moves when you navigate the nav bar, focus no longer jumps to random elements (nearest-neighbor recovery), DOWN at the bottom of any page enters the dock and UP from it returns to where you were. Live channel logos now retry through the image proxy before falling back, so far fewer blank tiles. Carries v3.12.83's StreamFlix structure and all earlier fixes.
